title: Online Conditional Vine Copulas: Forecasting Electricity Demand
abstract: arXiv:2610.23119v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We propose an online multivariate distributional forecasting model in which we condition the parameters of a vine copula on covariates. An online algorithm updates the parameters sequentially using only the most recent observations. Existing approaches require full batch re-estimation using all available data at each update step, which makes them computationally slow in large-scale forecasting applications and less suitable for settings in which dependence structures change over time. Simulation results show that the online procedure achieves forecasting performance comparable to that of the batch estimator, while reducing computation time substantially. We illustrate the method in a forecasting application to electricity net-demand across five regions of Great Britain and show that (i) the conditional vine copula model outperforms unconditional Gaussian and vine copula benchmarks and (ii) that online estimation improves forecast accur

translated_title: 在线条件藤Copula：电力需求预测
translated_abstract: 我们提出了一种在线多元分布预测模型，该模型将藤Copula的参数以协变量为条件。在线算法仅使用最新的观测值按顺序更新参数。现有方法在每次更新步骤中都需要使用所有可用数据进行完整的批量重新估计，这使得它们在大规模预测应用中计算缓慢，且不太适用于依赖结构随时间变化的场景。仿真结果表明，在线方法实现了与批量估计器相当的预测性能，同时大幅减少了计算时间。我们在对英国五个地区电力净需求的预测应用中展示了该方法，并表明：(i) 条件藤Copula模型的性能优于无条件的高斯Copula和藤Copula基准模型；(ii) 在线估计提高了预测精度。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种以协变量为条件的在线藤Copula多元分布预测模型，通过仅使用最新观测数据顺序更新参数，在大幅降低计算时间的同时达到与批量估计相当的预测性能，并在英国五个地区的电力净需求预测中验证了其优于传统基准模型的准确性和对时变依赖结构的适应性。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes an online conditional vine copula multivariate distributional forecasting model that sequentially updates parameters using only the most recent observations, substantially reducing computation time while achieving forecasting performance comparable to batch estimation, and demonstrates its superiority in forecasting electricity net-demand across five regions of Great Britain.
